text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here! It's time for Derby
Week!

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
On this week's show, we'll be bringing
you live
interviews with each of the
competitors! We'll be
kicking things off
with Ines Fujin! Can you hear
us?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is Ines Fujin, and I'm here with
my
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you certainly seem a little nervous
there,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
But that's not surprising when your
trainee is
competing in the Derby! Not
to mention, her
track record indicates
she has the talent to claim
victory!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In all honesty, have you ever felt
overwhelmed by
the responsibility on
your shoulders?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha. My trainer promised to lead me to
victory
as the number one favorite!
choice_data_list: None at all—I'm full of confidence!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty self-indulgent, to be fair. I've
only been
able to make it this far
because I have my trainer
and my family
behind me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (That's why I believe in them!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(My family isn't particularly wealthy. To
be
honest, I felt like I'd just be a burden
on them if I
enrolled in the academy.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But Mom and Dad told me not worry,
and my
little sisters cheered me on.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Even after all that, I still can't bring
myself to
fully depend on their
kindness.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I know I should concentrate more on my
training,
but I want to keep working
part-time to support
my sisters as they
pursue their dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Yet in spite of all that hassle, my trainer
still
chose to accept me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My trainer is truly amazing. So just sit
back and
watch us achieve greatness.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When the two of us put our heads
together, we're
unstoppable. Even if we
get marked as the
favorites, I know we'll
still pull through.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My dream right now is to win the Derby
as the
number one favorite!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder if I came on a little too
strong
during the interview.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to lose after saying all that.

Heh-heh, are you ready for this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I know you have faith in me.
choice_data_list: I've always believed you can win.
I've always believed you can win.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm going to pour everything I
have
into the race ahead of us!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whatever it takes to win!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!
Go Ines!
You can do it, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible atmosphere! We just
received
confirmation that we've got an
all-time record
number of spectators
here for today's Derby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, Ines. This is our first race together
since the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yes, and that was only a month ago.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I can see you've grown even more

dependable, Ryan. Each time we meet,
it's like
you're a whole different person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You think so? ...Haha, well, it's an honor
to hear
you say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You probably don't realize it, but you're
the one
who brought me this far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I watched you, it helped me bring
my own
dream into focus.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Your dream?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can't let you win the Derby!
No
matter how hard you try to break
away, I'll
overtake you in the end!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Listen, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! Do your beeest!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's not gonna happen. I won't let you
snatch
victory out of my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we'll just have to settle this
on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, game on!
After all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This isn't just my dream that I'm fighting
for.
